title: OLX.ba Daily Rent
description: For hosts and short-stay investors: what homes let by the night ask (Stan na dan apartments and holiday cottages at nightly prices), where they are, and how supply moves. Nightly prices are kept apart from monthly rent.

filters.name: rooms
filters.label: Rooms
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(rooms,'unknown') AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND deal = 'daily_rent' ORDER BY 1

filters.name: neighborhood
filters.label: Neighborhood
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(neighborhood,'unknown') AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND deal = 'daily_rent' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Active daily rentals
panels.sql: WITH coverage AS (SELECT (min(started_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AS start FROM lean.scrape_runs), base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND l.deal = 'daily_rent' AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), changes AS (SELECT article_id, price_date FROM (SELECT ph.article_id, ph.price_date, ph.price, lag(ph.price) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.article_id ORDER BY ph.price_date, ph.id) AS previous FROM lean.price_history ph JOIN base USING (article_id) WHERE ph.source = 'api_price_history' AND ph.price > 0) history WHERE price <> previous) SELECT count(*) AS active, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE price > 0)::numeric, 0) AS median_night, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (first_seen > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND first_seen <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) AS new_n, (SELECT CASE WHEN (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) >= (SELECT start FROM coverage) THEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE (p.first_seen > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND p.first_seen <= (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) END AS n FROM lean.listings p WHERE p.deal = 'daily_rent' AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(p.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(p.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR p.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR p.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) AS new_prev, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE seller_type = 'shop') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE seller_type IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS agency_share_pct, round(100.0 * (SELECT count(DISTINCT article_id) FROM changes WHERE (price_date > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND price_date <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS repriced_pct, round(100.0 * (SELECT count(DISTINCT article_id) FROM changes WHERE (price_date > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND price_date <= (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS repriced_pct_prev FROM base

panels.title: Neighborhoods compared
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND l.deal = 'daily_rent' AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT coalesce(neighborhood, 'unknown') AS neighborhood, count(*) AS listings, round(percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE price > 0)::numeric, 0) AS p25, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE price > 0)::numeric, 0) AS median_night, round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE price > 0)::numeric, 0) AS p75, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (first_seen > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND first_seen <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) AS new_n FROM base GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY listings DESC, neighborhood

panels.title: Price per night
panels.description: Active daily rentals by asking price per night.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND l.deal = 'daily_rent' AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT CASE WHEN price < 50 THEN 'under 50 KM' WHEN price < 80 THEN '50–79 KM' WHEN price < 120 THEN '80–119 KM' WHEN price < 200 THEN '120–199 KM' ELSE '200+ KM' END AS price_band, count(*) AS listings FROM base WHERE price > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(price)

panels.title: Price per night over time
panels.description: Median and interquartile range of the asking price per night of daily rentals active at each day's end. Each listing carries the price OLX reported for that day. Listings without a reported price history carry their current price from the day they were first seen.
panels.sql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date(${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo') AS start_day,
         LEAST(date(${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AS end_day
), stays AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT l.article_id, l.price, l.first_seen
  FROM lean.listings l
  WHERE l.deal = 'daily_rent'
    AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)
), openings AS (
  SELECT article_id, first_seen AS opened_at FROM stays
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.article_id, e.occurred_at AS opened_at
  FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e
  JOIN stays s USING (article_id)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'reopened'
), cycles AS (
  SELECT o.article_id, o.opened_at, c.closed_at
  FROM openings o
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT min(e.occurred_at) AS closed_at
    FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e
    WHERE e.article_id = o.article_id
      AND e.event_type = 'closed'
      AND e.occurred_at > o.opened_at
  ) c ON TRUE
), prior_prices AS (
  SELECT s.article_id, price.price, price.price_date
  FROM stays s
  CROSS JOIN bounds
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ph.price, ph.price_date
    FROM lean.price_history ph
    WHERE ph.article_id = s.article_id
      AND ph.source = 'api_price_history'
      AND ph.price > 0
      AND ph.price_date < bounds.start_day
    ORDER BY ph.price_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) price
), window_prices AS (
  SELECT s.article_id, price.price, price.price_date
  FROM stays s
  CROSS JOIN bounds
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ph.price, ph.price_date
    FROM lean.price_history ph
    WHERE ph.article_id = s.article_id
      AND ph.source = 'api_price_history'
      AND ph.price > 0
      AND ph.price_date BETWEEN bounds.start_day AND bounds.end_day
  ) price
), price_spans AS (
  SELECT relevant.article_id, relevant.price, relevant.price_date,
         lead(relevant.price_date) OVER (
           PARTITION BY relevant.article_id ORDER BY relevant.price_date
         ) AS next_date
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM prior_prices
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM window_prices
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.article_id, s.price, s.first_seen
    FROM stays s
    WHERE s.price > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM lean.price_history ph
      WHERE ph.article_id = s.article_id AND ph.source = 'api_price_history' AND ph.price > 0
    )
  ) relevant
), daily AS (
  SELECT d.day::date AS day, p.price AS night
  FROM price_spans p
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    GREATEST(p.price_date, b.start_day),
    LEAST(COALESCE(p.next_date - 1, b.end_day), b.end_day),
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  ) AS d(day) ON TRUE
  JOIN cycles c
    ON c.article_id = p.article_id
   AND c.opened_at < d.day::date + 1
   AND (c.closed_at IS NULL OR c.closed_at >= d.day::date + 1)
)
SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY night) AS p25,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY night) AS median,
       percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY night) AS p75,
       count(*) AS listings
FROM daily GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Newest listings
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND l.deal = 'daily_rent' AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT title, url, neighborhood, rooms, sqm, price, seller_type, first_seen FROM base WHERE (first_seen > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND first_seen <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) ORDER BY first_seen DESC, article_id DESC LIMIT 50
panels.description: First seen in the selected time window, newest first.

panels.title: Recent price cuts
panels.sql: WITH prices AS (SELECT article_id, price_date, price, lag(price) OVER (PARTITION BY article_id ORDER BY price_date, id) AS previous_price FROM lean.price_history WHERE price IS NOT NULL AND source = 'api_price_history'), cuts AS (SELECT article_id, price_date, previous_price, price FROM prices WHERE previous_price > price) SELECT l.title, l.url, l.neighborhood, l.rooms, c.previous_price AS was, c.price AS now, round(100.0 * (1 - c.price / c.previous_price), 1) AS cut_pct, c.price_date FROM cuts c JOIN lean.listings l USING (article_id) WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND l.deal = 'daily_rent' AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (c.price_date > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND c.price_date <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) ORDER BY c.price_date DESC, cut_pct DESC, l.article_id LIMIT 25
panels.description: Price cuts in the selected time window on active listings, newest first.
